description: A pre-Windows-XP file entry: two names back to back, no extension block
notes: Nothing in the item says which layout it is. The u16 after the primary name would be an extension block's size on Windows XP and later; here it is the first two bytes of 'LONGNA~1.TXT', 0x4F4C = 20300, larger than the whole item -- which is exactly how libfwsi decides the item is pre-XP.
